answer: Streak multiplier at the vine: each epoch of verified work multiplies reputation by 1.05, capped at 10x. Saffron-weighted slashing burns 3 epochs of accrued multiplier on any failed challenge. A farm splitting into n fresh identities resets to 1x each epoch, capping at 3x while honest streaks reach the summit of 10x, so farming costs 70% more work per unit influence.
